title: Burundi calculator readiness research — Batch 39

findings.detail: FAO estimates 2025 aggregate cereal production at 789,000 tonnes, 5% below the previous five-year average. Seasons A, B and C had different outcomes; 2025B was below average, while 2025A and C were above average.
FAO reports below-average 2026A production risk from insufficient and poorly distributed rainfall, including substantial maize and bean crop losses in several lowland areas.
PNISAN/WFP July 2026 national retail medians: white maize 1,450 BIF/kg, yellow beans 2,867 BIF/kg, cassava flour 1,567 BIF/kg. These are retail prices, not farm-gate producer prices.
Since 2025 Burundi has five provinces and 42 communes: Buhumuza, Bujumbura, Burunga, Butanyerera and Gitega. Historical agriculture indicators remain on the old 18-province geography.
Current farmer-paid input costs, labour, machinery, irrigation and region-specific gross-margin budgets remain unverified.
